plot-title: The grounding of the extracted spans
plot-caption: The share of the spans of each class whose text equals the source slice, character for character (`is_verbatim`), over the reasoning and response fields. Hollow: the F4 prompt; filled: the F9 prompt. The aligner checks this for every span; it is not an estimate. A verbatim span exists in the text, but its class and its attributes can still be wrong.
